title: Alert
description: The content of the plain-text Alert email to the Integration Team mailbox (UC-006, BR-006). Trailhead Gear owns it. It allows no other field, so that no Customer name, email address or Shipping Address can get into it (UC-006 BR-004, NFR-011). How the text is laid out is not part of the model.

kind.description: What the Alert is about: Accepted Orders not sent to the warehouse in 30 minutes (UC-006 step 2), Peakmart Orders waiting 2 hours to be checked or recorded (UC-006 A1), a Set-Aside Order Event (UC-006 A3), or the Peakmart order topic not read for 15 minutes (UC-006 A4).

raisedAt.description: Date and time the Alert was raised, in UTC.

orders.description: Every Order that passed the same time limit at the same time, one Alert for all of them (UC-006 BR-005). Only for `not-sent-to-warehouse` and `peakmart-order-waiting`.

orderNumber.description: Order Number of the stuck Order.

waitingFor.description: For `peakmart-order-waiting`: whether the Peakmart Order waits to be checked or to be recorded (UC-006 A1).

since.description: When the Order was recorded (`not-sent-to-warehouse`) or arrived (`peakmart-order-waiting`), in UTC.

waitingMinutes.description: How long the Order has been waiting, in minutes; time inside the Maintenance Window is not counted for `not-sent-to-warehouse` (UC-006 BR-001).

eventId.description: Event id of the Set-Aside Order Event; only for `order-event-set-aside` (UC-006 A3).

orderNumber.description: Order Number of the Set-Aside Order Event when it can be read; only for `order-event-set-aside`.

arrivedAt.description: When the Set-Aside Order Event arrived, in UTC; only for `order-event-set-aside`.

lastReadAt.description: When the Peakmart order topic was last read, in UTC; only for `peakmart-topic-not-read` (UC-006 A4).
